### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the alpha-compositing change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #3863 by correcting alpha compositing in `ImageOverlayConverter`, so translucent overlays no longer reduce the opacity of opaque base images. **Changes:** - Replaces masked paste with a transparent overlay layer and source-over compositing via `Image.alpha_composite`. - Adds regression tests for translucent pixel blending and clipping overlays that extend beyond the base image. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit/​converter/​test_image_overlay_converter.py` | Adds pixel-level compositing and out-of-bounds clipping tests. | | `pyrit/​converter/​image_overlay_converter.py` | Uses source-over compositing while preserving existing opacity and JPEG handling. |
Review effort: Balanced
